subject.title: feature: system event priority/bypass-queue mode for reliable in-session alerts

question: Should OpenClaw add an urgent system-alert contract here, and should that contract be operator-visible only, prompt-visible session injection, or both?
rationale: Automation can prove the current queued wake behavior, but the remaining choice changes trusted session content, busy-lane ordering, and incident-alert UX.

options.title: Split UI Alert From Prompt Injection
options.body: Add an immediate operator-visible alert path first, and keep prompt-visible transcript mutation behind a separate explicit trusted event contract.

options.title: Add Prompt-Visible Priority Injection
options.body: Allow high-priority system events to bypass busy lanes, but require typed auth, sanitization, ordering, replay, and busy-lane tests before merge.

options.title: Keep Best-Effort Wake Semantics
options.body: Decline queue bypass and document external transports or node notifications as the real-time alert path during provider incidents.

recommendation.title: Split UI Alert From Prompt Injection
recommendation.body: Add an immediate operator-visible alert path first, and keep prompt-visible transcript mutation behind a separate explicit trusted event contract.
